mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return anticipation as investors price in higher future rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3 in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month period, 20-day forward returns do not underperform the 5-day moving average during inflation spikes above 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressure, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: In regimes with stable labor costs, the 60-day forward return outperforms the 20-day baseline with p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% suggests strengthening supply-side demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST grows > 2% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is not statistically different from zero when demand momentum is absent.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO supply index below 90 for three consecutive months indicates softening manufacturing capacity, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During supply shocks, the 20-day forward return is positive or non-significant.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to turn negative due to higher discount rates eroding future equity value.
failure_condition: In high-rate environments, the 20-day forward return is not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 5% in a labor market expansion regime is associated with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as lower unemployment signals economic resilience.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% in a labor expansion regime
failure_condition: During contraction, the 60-day forward return is negative or flat.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail) above their 2020 Q1 averages for two months predict a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as market anticipates sustained economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2020Q1 avg & RSAFS > 2020Q1 avg for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant return predictability when proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 below their 2019 Q4 averages for 3 months indicates structural supply constraints, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 2019Q4 avg & GDPC1 < 2019Q4 avg for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive when only one index is constrained.
